name: Vampire Weaknesses
description: The creature has the following flaws:

mechanics.text: The creature has the following flaws:
The creature can't enter a residence without an invitation from one of the occupants.
The creature takes 20 acid damage when it ends its turn in running water.
The creature is destroyed if a piercing weapon made of wood is driven into its heart while it is incapacitated in its resting place.
The creature takes 20 radiant damage when it starts its turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.
